content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have an input that, when triggered, overlaps with another activation of the same input. How can I store or manage this input so the program processes each one in sequence after the previous input is finished?
Apologies, I don't fully understand your question. Could you provide more details?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing an issue where concurrent or rapidly repeating input signals may not be processed correctly with [company_name] automation equipment. The main usability concern is ensuring that simultaneous or quickly recurring inputs are all detected, queued, and processed one after another without missing any signals.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the system to reliably queue or buffer all incoming input signals and guarantee that each signal is processed in arrival order without skipping any.
